_comment: Krea-2 Turbo text-to-image. Needs the 'krea2' service installed + running (default port 17910). Web app: open via Flows sidebar → 'Load from File' (adds it as a new flow). CLI: oaiy run examples/krea2-text-to-image.json
name: Krea-2 Turbo text-to-image
